stats.description: Counts the valid configured blue (defensive) attributes in the Investor mask's three bonus slots, for Slotted. The core, Expertise and mods do not count.

stats.name: Investor Yellow Attributes
stats.description: Counts the valid configured yellow (skill) attributes in the Investor mask's three bonus slots, for Slotted. The core, Expertise and mods do not count.

stats.name: Weapon Falloff Floor
stats.description: Share of full damage the weapon deals from long range out to maximum range: myDamageMin / myDamageMax of the weapon's source declaration (linear between optimal and long range, no damage beyond maximum range). 1 means no falloff, which also stands for weapons whose source identity is unresolved.

stats.name: Doctor Home Kit Repair
stats.description: Armor repaired by Doctor Home's kit, as a share of maximum armor, when a target it marked dies (no bonus armor). The driven fight applies it through the kit rule; it is not a per-kill repair.

stats.name: Afterburn Detonation Damage
stats.description: Damage of one Afterburn detonation on the current enemy: stacks x 100% x weapon damage per pellet, with no critical or headshot damage and no falloff. Armor and health are hit directly, without armor or health damage factors.

stats.name: Apex Protocol 4-piece
stats.description: 1 while Apex Protocol's 4-piece bonus applies, otherwise 0. Veer Override's damage reads it, so that the mark is only read with the talent selected.

stats.name: Overcharge Bonus
stats.description: The source SkillPowerOverchargeFlatBonus. Added after Skill Tier is capped at 6, up to tier 7: Min(Min(tier bonuses, 6) + this, 7). Energize and One in the Hand add to it, so they are +1 below tier 6 and tier 7 at it.

stats.name: Effective Skill Tier
stats.description: Min(Min(tier bonuses, 6) + Overcharge bonus, 7), the one definition every skill output reads.
stats.formula: min(7, min(6, max(0, floor(skill_tier))) + max(0, floor(skill_overcharge)))

stats.name: Effective Shield Skill Tier
stats.description: The same, for shields, which count armor cores toward Skill Tier.
stats.formula: min(7, min(6, max(0, floor(skill_tier + armor_core_count))) + max(0, floor(skill_overcharge)))

selectors.name: Aces & Eights empowered shot
selectors.description: Assume the next eligible Rifle or Marksman Rifle shot is empowered. Card flips and enhanced-shot consumption are not tracked.

selectors.name: Acosta grenade skill-tier bonus
selectors.description: Assume the skill-tier bonus from throwing a grenade is active. At Skill Tier 6 it gives tier 7.

selectors.name: Adrenaline Rush bonus active
selectors.description: Assume the proximity bonus armor is active. With several enemies firing at once, fights set this while an enemy is within 10m. Otherwise, set it here, and the stack count separately.

selectors.name: Aggressive Recon damage bonus
selectors.description: Assume the Signature Weapon damage bonus after a Signature Weapon kill is active. Select the next-reload bonus separately.

selectors.name: Aggressive Recon next reload
selectors.description: Assume the next reload qualifies for Aggressive Recon's reload-speed bonus. Select its damage bonus separately.

selectors.name: Agonizing Bite marked shot
selectors.description: Assume this shot hits the enemy marked by Diamondback. This does not choose or consume a mark.

selectors.name: Back and Forth swap-to bonus
selectors.description: Assume the bonus from swapping to this weapon is active. This does not select the separate swap-from bonus.

selectors.name: Binary Trigger empowered shot
selectors.description: Assume the shot qualifies for Binary Trigger's empowered damage. This does not build stacks or calculate the explosion.

selectors.name: Boiling Point magazine phase
selectors.description: Choose early for the first magazine portion with reduced critical hit chance, or late for the remaining portion with increased critical hit chance. The equipped talent determines the split.

selectors.name: Bond proximity bonus
selectors.description: Choose ally when an ally is within 10 meters, or skill when one of your skills is within 10 meters. Select only the applicable bonus; the ally bonus is higher.

selectors.name: Brazen next-shot bonus
selectors.description: Assume the next shot qualifies for Brazen. Set the previous shot's pellet hits separately.

selectors.name: Challenger nearby-enemy resistance
selectors.description: Assume the evaluated incoming damage comes from an enemy within 20 meters for Challenger.

selectors.name: Chameleon body-shot bonus
selectors.description: Assume Adaptive Instincts' weapon damage bonus from body shots is active.

selectors.name: Chameleon headshot bonus
selectors.description: Assume Adaptive Instincts' critical hit bonuses from headshots are active.

selectors.name: Chameleon leg-shot bonus
selectors.description: Assume Adaptive Instincts' reload-speed bonus from leg shots is active.

selectors.name: Close & Personal bonus active
selectors.description: Assume the weapon damage bonus after a qualifying close-range kill is active.

selectors.name: Clutch repair condition
selectors.description: Choose low_armor when below the equipped talent's armor threshold, or post_kill while its repair bonus after a kill is active. Set missing armor separately.

selectors.name: Combat Medic revive protection
selectors.description: Assume Combat Medic's damage resistance applies during a revive or its protection period afterward.

selectors.name: Combined Arms bonus active
selectors.description: Assume the skill damage bonus from shooting an enemy is active.

selectors.name: Spontaneous Combustion initial-burn bonus
selectors.description: Assume the target qualifies for the burn damage bonus from an initially applied Burn. This does not select a random burn proc or apply a status.

selectors.name: Companion proximity bonus
selectors.description: Assume an ally or skill is within the equipped talent's required distance.

selectors.name: Concussion headshot bonus
selectors.description: Assume the bonus from landing a headshot is active. Select the headshot-kill bonus separately.

selectors.name: Concussion headshot-kill bonus
selectors.description: Assume the bonus from a headshot kill is active. Select the headshot-hit bonus separately.

selectors.name: Counter bonus group
selectors.description: Choose handling for magazine size and reload speed, or offense for weapon damage and rate of fire. Assume that group is currently active after a weapon swap.

selectors.name: Empathic Resolve self-repair bonus
selectors.description: Assume the reduced self-repair damage bonus is active. This is separate from a bonus received by an ally.

selectors.name: Energize skill-tier bonus
selectors.description: Assume the skill-tier bonus from an armor kit is active. Fights with armor kits follow it. At Skill Tier 6 it gives tier 7.

selectors.name: Entrench repair available
selectors.description: Assume an eligible headshot from cover while below the armor threshold, with the repair ready.

selectors.name: Target ignited by Ortiz prototype turret
selectors.description: Assume this target was ignited by your Ortiz prototype Incinerator Turret for Heatstroke. A generic burning target does not establish this condition.

selectors.name: Faster Than Reloading primed bonus
selectors.description: Assume the primed weapon has been drawn and its damage and rate-of-fire bonuses remain active.

selectors.name: Feedback Loop bonus active
selectors.description: Assume the damage and repair bonuses from Feedback Loop are active. This does not reset the other skill or advance cooldowns.

selectors.name: Finisher swap-from bonus
selectors.description: Assume the critical hit bonuses from swapping away after a qualifying kill are active.

selectors.name: First Blood eligible scoped shot
selectors.description: Assume an eligible opening shot while scoped with the required magnification. This does not track reloads or remaining eligible shots.

selectors.name: Frenzy bonus active
selectors.description: Assume the damage and rate-of-fire bonuses from reloading an empty magazine are active.

selectors.name: At full armor
selectors.description: Assume your armor is full for effects that require full armor.

selectors.name: Galvanize bonus armor active
selectors.description: Assume the bonus armor from applying an eligible status effect is active.

selectors.name: Gangland Hit marked target
selectors.description: Assume this target is marked for Gangland Hit. Fights follow your mark: it lands on a hit, and leaves when you move to another enemy. Set the mark count separately.

selectors.name: Gunslinger bonus active
selectors.description: Assume the weapon-swap damage bonus is active and not in its lockout period.

selectors.name: Hotshot empowered headshot
selectors.description: Assume an eligible Marksman Rifle headshot receives Headache's next-headshot bonus. This does not progress the headshot cycle.

selectors.name: High Priority Target eligible enemy
selectors.description: Assume this enemy qualifies as the highest-ranking enemy currently in combat under the talent's hierarchy.

selectors.name: Hollow-Point Ammo active
selectors.description: Assume the current shot uses Ongoing Directive's Hollow-Point Ammo. This does not grant ammunition or apply bleed.

selectors.name: Hunter's Fury target within 15 m
selectors.description: Assume the target is within 15 meters for Hunter's Fury.

selectors.name: In cover
selectors.description: Assume you are in cover for effects that require cover.

selectors.name: In Sync skill-use trigger
selectors.description: Assume using a skill or dealing skill damage has activated In Sync's weapon damage bonus. Select the weapon-hit trigger separately.

selectors.name: In Sync weapon-hit trigger
selectors.description: Assume a weapon hit has activated In Sync's skill damage bonus. Select the skill-use trigger separately.

selectors.name: Intimidate eligible close target
selectors.description: Assume bonus armor and a target within 10 meters make Intimidate eligible. Set the current stack count separately.

selectors.name: Killer bonus active
selectors.description: Assume the critical hit damage bonus after a critical-hit kill is active.

selectors.name: Lady Death empowered shot
selectors.description: Assume Breathe Free has a stack available to empower this shot. Movement and stack consumption are not tracked.

selectors.name: Leadership cover-to-cover bonus
selectors.description: Choose close when the cover-to-cover move ended within 10 meters of an enemy, or normal for the ordinary bonus. The equipped talent determines the bonus armor amount.

selectors.name: Mad Bomber aiming a grenade
selectors.description: Assume you are aiming a grenade for Mad Bomber's bonus armor.

selectors.name: Mantis target is not targeting you
selectors.description: Assume the target is not targeting you for Mantis's In Plain Sight effect.

selectors.name: Measured magazine half
selectors.description: Choose top for the first half of the magazine, or bottom for the second half. The equipped talent determines the weapon damage and rate-of-fire changes.

selectors.name: Memento short-term trophy bonus
selectors.description: Assume the short-term trophy bonus is active. Its amounts depend on equipped cores; long-term stacks are separate.

selectors.name: Mosquito Song target debuff
selectors.description: Assume the target has Mosquito Song's damage-to-armor debuff. This does not build stacks or change enemy targeting.

selectors.name: Naked headshot bonus active
selectors.description: Assume the headshot damage bonus from hitting an enemy without armor is active.

selectors.name: On Empty handling bonus
selectors.description: Assume the weapon handling bonus from reloading an empty magazine is active.

selectors.name: On Point post-reload bonus
selectors.description: Assume the post-reload bonus is active for the selected Rifle or Marksman Rifle. Set the stack count separately.

selectors.name: Opportunistic target debuff
selectors.description: Assume this target has the damage amplification from a qualifying Shotgun or Marksman Rifle hit.

selectors.name: Ortiz highlighted body section hit
selectors.description: Assume the shot hits the body section highlighted by Ortiz Assault Interface while scoped.

selectors.name: Ostracize unmarked target
selectors.description: Assume this target is unmarked and eligible for Ostracize's damage bonus. This does not assign the mark to another enemy.

selectors.name: Outsider range and accuracy bonus
selectors.description: Assume the range and accuracy bonuses after a kill are active.

selectors.name: Overclock deployed-skill proximity
selectors.description: Assume you are within the equipped talent's required distance of a deployed skill.

selectors.name: Overflowing expanded magazine
selectors.description: Assume the magazine-capacity bonus from the required empty reloads is active. Reload counts are not tracked.

selectors.name: Overwatch cover bonus
selectors.description: Assume the required time in cover has passed and Overwatch remains active in cover or during a cover-to-cover move.

selectors.name: Pack Instincts range bonus
selectors.description: Choose close for the 0–15 meter bonus, mid for the 15–25 meter bonus, or far for the 25 meter and beyond bonus. Use the distance of the last enemy hit, rather than the current target distance.

selectors.name: Parkour bonus armor active
selectors.description: Assume the bonus armor from a cover-to-cover move or vault is active.

selectors.name: Perpetuation next status bonus
selectors.description: Assume the next status effect qualifies for Perpetuation's damage and duration bonus. This does not apply or time a status.

selectors.name: Perturb primed swap-to bonus
selectors.description: Assume the primed weapon has been drawn and Perturb's active bonuses remain in effect.

selectors.name: Precision Strike close-range bonus
selectors.description: Assume the stacks have been used to activate the close-range damage bonus. Set the applicable stack count separately.

selectors.name: Preservation kill type
selectors.description: Choose body for an ordinary kill, or headshot for a headshot kill. The equipped talent determines the armor repair over time.

selectors.name: Protected Reload bonus armor
selectors.description: Assume you are reloading for Protected Reload's personal bonus armor.

selectors.name: Protector shield-hit bonus
selectors.description: Assume the personal bonus armor from your shield taking damage is active.

selectors.name: Pummel damage bonus
selectors.description: Assume the damage bonus from the required consecutive kills is active. This does not refill the magazine.

selectors.name: Reactant bonus active
selectors.description: Assume a qualifying kill at maximum Catalysis stacks has activated Reactant: bonus armor and 20% reload speed for 5s.

selectors.name: Reformation repair bonus
selectors.description: Assume the skill repair bonus from a headshot is active.

selectors.name: Restrained shield-break bonus
selectors.description: Assume the pistol damage bonus after your shield breaks is active.

selectors.name: Rigger interacted-skill bonus
selectors.description: Assume Tend and Befriend's bonus applies to the skill being evaluated. This does not establish that both equipped skills qualify.

selectors.name: Sawyer's damage bonus active
selectors.description: Assume Stand Your Ground's damage bonus is currently valid. Set the accumulated stationary stacks separately.

selectors.name: Seeing Red active
selectors.description: Assume Over the top's Seeing Red bonuses are active after a qualifying grenade or melee hit.

selectors.name: Septic Shock nine-stack debuff
selectors.description: Assume the target has reached the nine-stack damage-taken debuff. This does not apply its earlier status effects.

selectors.name: Shakedown shot type
selectors.description: No longer read: Shakedown applies its bonuses by the kind of hit. Safe to remove.

selectors.name: Shock and Awe bonus active
selectors.description: Assume the skill damage and repair bonuses from applying a status effect are active.

selectors.name: Signature Moves damage bonus
selectors.description: Assume the selected Signature Moves bonus after depleting Signature Weapon ammunition is active.

selectors.name: Sledgehammer marked target
selectors.description: Assume this target has your Sledgehammer grenade mark for the damage-to-armor bonus.

selectors.name: Soft Spot damage bonus
selectors.description: Assume the weapon damage bonus from destroying a weakpoint is active.

selectors.name: Spark damage bonus
selectors.description: Assume the weapon damage bonus from dealing skill damage is active.

selectors.name: Spike skill damage bonus
selectors.description: Assume the skill damage bonus from a headshot is active.

selectors.name: Startling out-of-cover bonus
selectors.description: Assume the damage-to-targets-out-of-cover bonus after suppressing an enemy is active.

selectors.name: Streamline skill condition met
selectors.description: Assume no skill is deployed or on cooldown, making Streamline's weapon damage bonus eligible.

selectors.name: Swift damage bonus
selectors.description: Assume the weapon damage bonus from a cover-to-cover move is active.

selectors.name: Symphony active range bonus
selectors.description: Choose beyond for the bonus from a kill beyond 25 meters, within for the bonus from a kill within 25 meters, or both for the simultaneous enhanced bonuses. This selects an active bonus; it does not build stacks or advance its timer.

selectors.name: Target is bleeding
selectors.description: Assume the target is bleeding. This does not apply bleeding or determine its duration.

selectors.name: Target is blinded
selectors.description: Assume the target is blinded. This does not apply blind or determine its duration.

selectors.name: Target is burning
selectors.description: Assume the target is burning. This does not apply burn or determine its duration.

selectors.name: Target is confused
selectors.description: Assume the target is confused. This does not apply confusion or determine its duration.

selectors.name: Target is ensnared
selectors.description: Assume the target is ensnared. This does not apply ensnare or determine its duration.

selectors.name: Target is not targeting you
selectors.description: Assume the target is not targeting you for Behind You. This is separate from the Mantis assumption.

selectors.name: Target is pulsed
selectors.description: Assume the target is pulsed for effects that require a pulsed target.

selectors.name: Target is shocked
selectors.description: Assume the target is shocked. This does not apply shock or determine its duration.

selectors.name: Target has a status effect
selectors.description: Assume the target has a status effect for effects with that condition. Individual status assumptions are selected separately.

selectors.name: Tech Support damage bonus
selectors.description: Assume the skill damage bonus after a skill kill is active.

selectors.name: True Patriot Blue on enemy
selectors.description: Assume the evaluated enemy has Blue for its outgoing damage reduction. This does not reduce all incoming damage.

selectors.name: True Patriot Red on target
selectors.description: Assume the target has Red for the selected weapon's damage amplification.

selectors.name: True Patriot White repair ready
selectors.description: Assume an eligible hit on a White target with the repair available. This does not advance the repair timer.

selectors.name: Umbra Into the Light bonus
selectors.description: Assume Into the Light's critical hit damage and rate-of-fire bonuses are eligible and not suppressed by shooting from cover. Set stacks separately.

selectors.name: Unbreakable repair ready
selectors.description: Assume armor depletion can trigger the repair and its cooldown is ready.

selectors.name: Unwavering handling bonus
selectors.description: Assume the handling bonus from swapping to this weapon is active and not locked out.

selectors.name: Versatile eligible swap bonus
selectors.description: Assume the weapon swap, weapon types and target distance qualify for Versatile's damage bonus.

selectors.name: Vigilance damage bonus
selectors.description: Assume Vigilance is active and not disabled by recent incoming damage.

selectors.name: Vindictive critical hit bonuses
selectors.description: Assume the critical hit bonuses after killing a status-affected enemy are active.

selectors.name: Weakest Link eligible enemy
selectors.description: Assume this enemy qualifies as the lowest-ranking enemy currently in combat under the talent's hierarchy.

selectors.name: Wicked damage bonus
selectors.description: Assume the weapon damage bonus from applying a status effect is active.

selectors.name: Full Stop headshot-kill refill
selectors.description: Marks a simulated headshot-kill magazine refill. It grants no damage or armor bonus and does not count as a reload.

selectors.name: Concussion marksman-rifle headshot bonus
selectors.description: Assume the 5 s bonus from landing a headshot with a marksman rifle is active. It is separate from the headshot bonus of other weapons and from the headshot-kill bonus.

selectors.name: Resolved conversion ready
selectors.description: Assume the next body shot from a marksman rifle, rifle or pistol is converted to a headshot (2 s cooldown after the hit that spends it).

selectors.name: Ablative Nano-Plating self grant ready
selectors.description: Assume your next armor break grants 80% of your armor as bonus armor for 10s (45s cooldown from that break).

selectors.name: Steady Handed refill
selectors.description: Marks the hit that reaches the stack cap and refills the magazine; it has no stat effect of its own.

selectors.name: Clutch post-kill window
selectors.description: Assume Clutch's post-kill window is open: critical hits repair missing armor at any armor level.

selectors.name: Clutch critical-hit repair
selectors.description: Marks the instant of a Clutch repair in driven fights; it changes no stat.

selectors.name: Preservation repair running
selectors.description: Assume a Preservation kill repair is running (5 s); it changes no stat.

selectors.name: Preservation headshot repair running
selectors.description: Assume a Preservation headshot-kill bonus repair is running (5 s); it changes no stat.

selectors.name: Doctor Home target marked
selectors.description: Assume the current target carries Doctor Home's mark (5 s after your last hit): its death drops the armor kit.

selectors.name: Doctor Home kit
selectors.description: Marks the instant of a Doctor Home kit in driven fights; it changes no stat.

selectors.name: Veer Override mark
selectors.description: Assume the target carries the Veer Override mark: at maximum Apex Engine bonus stacks, your skill damage marks it for 10s.

selectors.name: Hardened Armor Kits bonus armor
selectors.description: Assume the bonus armor from an armor kit is active. Fights with armor kits follow the node, and it changes nothing outside a fight.

selectors.name: Stimulant Patch weapon handling
selectors.description: Assume the weapon handling from an armor kit is active. Fights with armor kits follow it.

selectors.name: Emergency Cleanse resistances
selectors.description: Assume the burn and bleed resistance from an armor kit is active. Fights with armor kits follow it. Poison resistance has no stat here, and removing status effects is not modeled.

selectors.name: Future Perfect Overcharge
selectors.description: Assume the Overcharge from a weapon kill at Skill Tier 6 is active, Overcharge included in the tier. Fights follow it: 15 s of Overcharge, and the next can come 90 s after the grant.

numericInputs.name: Activity
numericInputs.description: Where the build is played. Raids, the Incursion and the Toxic Dark Zone normalize Prototype items: their attributes count at the bottom of the Prototype range and augments are disabled. The Blackout Dark Zone's PvP augment values are not modeled.

options.label: Raid, Incursion or Toxic Dark Zone

numericInputs.name: Target Out of Cover
numericInputs.description: Whether the selected enemy is out of cover, so Damage to Targets Out of Cover applies to weapon damage in the target estimates. Off by default.

numericInputs.name: Practical Hit Rate (%)
numericInputs.description: Share of shots that hit, for practical weapon DPS. Starts at 70%; an editable reference, not a measured accuracy.

numericInputs.name: Headshots among Hits (%)
numericInputs.description: Share of the hits that land on the head, for practical weapon DPS. Starts at 25%.

numericInputs.name: Charging Retained Eligible Seconds
numericInputs.description: Explicit retained qualifying charge progress, expressed as whole eligible seconds (0–14), not wall-clock time. Assumes those seconds qualified in combat and out of cover; caps protection at 50%, or 70% with selected Overcharging. Safe Charging changes gain from 5% to 10% per second. Zero asserts no retained protection. Does not infer combat, cover, Charged sharing, movement immunity, pauses, consumption, uptime or actual incoming hits.

numericInputs.name: Stoic Enemies Targeting You
numericInputs.description: Explicit qualifying enemies targeting you (0–8). No targeting is inferred. The combined player/Decoy count is limited to eight as a conservative planner bound; the current live cap needs verification. Four effective Aegis pieces required. Does not simulate incoming hits or protection stacking.

numericInputs.name: Stoic Additional Decoy Targets
numericInputs.description: Explicit additional enemies targeting your eligible Decoy, not already counted as targeting you (0–8). Requires equipped selected Deceit and four effective Aegis pieces. Combined targets are limited to eight as a planner bound. Does not infer an active Decoy, targets or group state.

numericInputs.name: Stoic Group Agents Including You
numericInputs.description: Assumed ordinary PvE group size including you (1–4); interprets the pinned 1.X rule as 1.1 for one agent through 1.4 for four. Solo counting and live resistance stacking need verification. No matchmaking, raid grouping, teammates or mitigation is inferred.

numericInputs.name: Headache Current Armor Pool
numericInputs.description: Explicit current armor value used as the source pool for Headache's available full-armor bonus-armor ceiling: 50%, or 100% with equipped selected Stand Tall. Zero means no supplied pool. The 0–10,000,000 bound is a planner limit. Does not substitute estimated maximum armor, infer full armor, eligible MMR headshots or cycle state, or grant bonus armor. This capacity is independent of the available repair budget and is not an executed conversion.

numericInputs.name: Umbra Shadow Stacks to Consume
numericInputs.description: Explicit Shadow stacks to consume in one continuous-cover repair estimate (0–100), capped at 50 or 100 with equipped selected Into the Light. Zero means no consumption asserted. Uses unadjusted 0.8% estimated maximum armor per stack and 10 stacks/s; delivery time is a continuous budget estimate, not a tick schedule. Does not infer retained stacks, actual consumption, cover eligibility, missing armor, repair scaling, regeneration or overlaps. Independent of the separate Light damage assumption.

numericInputs.name: Return to Sender Eligible Skill Damage
numericInputs.description: Explicit eligible damage actually dealt by your skills for one unadjusted PvE repair budget. Base self/ally shares are 10%/20%, or pinned catalog 25%/35% with selected Increased Interest. Zero asserts no event. The 0–10,000,000 bound is a planner limit. Does not infer hits from skill previews, mitigation, recipients, missing armor, repair scaling, overlaps or bonus-armor conversion.

numericInputs.name: Ground Control Eligible Ally Repair
numericInputs.description: Explicit eligible repair amount delivered to an ally for one Ground Control proximity budget. The unadjusted share is 60%, or 120% with selected Advanced Combat Tactics, for each eligible recipient. Zero asserts no event. The 0–10,000,000 bound is a planner limit. No distance, recipient count, missing armor, repair scaling or recursive feedback is inferred. Independent of the full-armor damage bonus.

numericInputs.name: Makeshift Qualifying Damage
numericInputs.description: Explicit eligible damage received by the agent or shield for a Makeshift Repairs budget estimate. The unadjusted source budget goes to each recipient, not split between them. Zero means no damage asserted. The 0–10,000,000 range is a planner bound, not a game cap. No hit, damage mitigation, missing armor, Repair Skills scaling, overlaps or actual recovery are inferred.

numericInputs.name: Hackstep Qualifying Bonus Armor (%)
numericInputs.description: Explicit bonus armor gained that currently qualifies for Hackstep Protocol's damage bonus, in percentage points of armor (0–100). The estimate uses 2% Total Weapon Damage per complete 5%, capped at 20%. Zero means inactive. No bonus armor, ability use, source eligibility, consumption, duration or damage events are inferred; the passive available grant does not fill this input.

numericInputs.name: Clutch Missing Armor (%)
numericInputs.description: Assumed missing fraction of estimated maximum armor, in percentage points (0–100), for one eligible Clutch critical hit. Zero means full armor. clutch_repair_state separately asserts eligibility, including its armor threshold or current post-kill window; this input does not activate the talent. No damage or repair sequence is simulated.

numericInputs.name: Rebalance Red Stacks
numericInputs.description: Assumed current Harrier Pride Red stacks (0–80), each adding 0.5% Weapon Damage. Red and Blue stacks together bank and clear on reaching 80, so at most 79 stay live; one colour alone can reach the cap. In simulated fights, kills and every third hit build Red stacks; reaching the cap banks both colours (Rebalance Banked inputs) and clears the stacks.

numericInputs.name: Rebalance Blue Stacks
numericInputs.description: Assumed current Harrier Pride Blue stacks (0–80), each adding 0.5% Damage Resistance. Red and Blue stacks together bank and clear on reaching 80, so at most 79 stay live; one colour alone can reach the cap. In simulated fights with incoming fire, every third hit taken builds a Blue stack; reaching the cap banks both colours (Rebalance Banked inputs) and clears the stacks.

numericInputs.name: Blossom Harvest Target Armor+Health %
numericInputs.description: Assumed combined armor and health the current target has remaining (0–100%, in steps of 10). First Bloom amplifies weapon damage by 3.3% per full 10%. Zero means no amplification; target health is not tracked.

numericInputs.name: Bleeding Edge Bleeding Enemies
numericInputs.description: Bleeding enemies within 15m (0–5) with Bleeding Edge (G403): 1 to 5 repair 3%, 6%, 12%, 24% or 48% of your armor per second, as Armor Regeneration. With several enemies firing at once, fights set this each second: the enemies bleeding within 15m, whatever applied it. Other fights read whether the target is bleeding, or this assumed value. Bleeding Edge's own hits apply the bleed within 15m.

numericInputs.name: Bob and Weave Meters Run
numericInputs.description: Assumed meters run in one cover-to-cover move with Bob and Weave (0–20), each repairing 5% of your total armor (G403). The 20 is a planner bound; healing of damage taken during the move is not modeled.

numericInputs.name: Hoarder Extra Enemies in the Blast
numericInputs.description: Assumed extra enemies caught in a grenade blast beyond the first (0–10), each adding 25% Grenade Damage with Hoarder (G402). The 10 is a planner bound.

numericInputs.name: Busy Little Bee Stacks
numericInputs.description: Assumed Busy Little Bee stacks carried into the swap (0–10), each amplifying weapon damage by 20% for 10 seconds after swapping away from the weapon (G401). Applies while another weapon is active. Stack generation from shots at different targets and the duration are not simulated.

numericInputs.name: Alternating Current Stacks
numericInputs.description: Assumed current Alternating Current stacks (0–10), each adding 2.5% Skill Damage (G398). The game puts the stacks on one skill at a time and moves them to the other after 10 seconds at the cap; the planner applies them to both skills' estimates. Stack generation and transfer are not simulated.

numericInputs.name: Shakedown Stacks
numericInputs.description: Shakedown stacks on the target (0–4): +4% on every hit per stack, and +11% more on a headshot, which spends them. Fights follow this: a body shot adds one for 10s, and a headshot, a kill or a move to another enemy clears them. Elsewhere it is an assumption. The weakpoint bonus is not simulated.

numericInputs.name: Bloodsucker Stacks
numericInputs.description: Assumed current retained Bloodsucker stacks (0–10). Kill generation, refresh, and 10-second duration are not simulated.

numericInputs.name: Adrenaline Rush Stacks
numericInputs.description: Adrenaline Rush stacks (0-3), one per enemy within 10m. With several enemies firing at once, fights follow the count. Other fights use this assumed value. The 5s duration and cooldown are not simulated.

numericInputs.name: Chemical Agent Catalysis Stacks
numericInputs.description: Assumed current Chemical Agent Catalysis stacks (0–12), each adding 2% Weapon Damage and 2% Status Effects. The Reactant bonus-armor branch uses reactant_active to assert the valid 5-second bonus after an enemy that was status affected is killed at max Catalysis; once asserted, it does not require the current stack input to remain at 12 or the current target to remain status affected. Stack generation, decay, timers, and kill events are not simulated.

numericInputs.name: Capacitance Stacks
numericInputs.description: Assumed currently retained Capacitance stacks (0–40), each adding 1.5% Skill Damage. Shooting, stack generation, and decay are not simulated.

numericInputs.name: Sawyer's Kneepads Stacks
numericInputs.description: Assumed currently retained Stand Your Ground stacks (0–10). sawyer_active asserts the valid buff, including stacks retained after moving and before their 10-second expiry. Movement, stack generation, and expiry are not simulated.

numericInputs.name: Memento Trophy Stacks
numericInputs.description: Assumed current long-term Memento trophies (0–30); each contributes 1% Weapon Damage, 1% Skill Efficiency, and 0.1% Armor Regeneration. The separate short-buff assumption uses automatically counted configured cores. Trophy collection and timers are excluded.

numericInputs.name: Liberty Stacks
numericInputs.description: Assumed current Liberty weapon-damage stacks (0–30), adding 2% Weapon Damage each. In simulated fights hits build stacks and headshots consume them, repairing a deployed, raised shield by 3% of its max health per stack (owner modeling decision, R34); nothing is repaired without a shield.

numericInputs.name: Incessant Chatter Magazine Stacks
numericInputs.description: Incessant Chatter magazine stacks (0-5), adding 25% Rate of Fire each. With several enemies firing at once, fights set this: the enemies within 15m when a reload ends, held for that magazine. Other fights use this assumed value. Kills and refill are not simulated.

numericInputs.name: Obliterate Stacks
numericInputs.description: Assumed current stack count. Perfect Obliterate caps at 24; ordinary Obliterate caps at 20. Critical-hit stack generation and the 10s timer are not simulated.

numericInputs.name: Unstoppable Force Stacks
numericInputs.description: Assumed current stack count (0-5). Kill cadence, the 15s timer, and grenade kills adding 2 stacks are not simulated.

numericInputs.name: Strained Stacks
numericInputs.description: Assumed current firing stack count. Perfect Strained caps at 8; ordinary Strained caps at 5. Firing time and stack generation are not simulated. Only critical hit damage is added; critical damage is not applied to the weapon preview.

numericInputs.name: Magazine Ammo Missing (%)
numericInputs.description: Assumed missing percentage of the selected weapon's magazine. Optimist scales continuously and linearly from the source wording; 100% is a theoretical empty-magazine boundary, not a firing state or ammo simulation.

numericInputs.name: Fast Hands Stacks
numericInputs.description: Assumed current stack count (0-40). Critical-hit stack generation is not simulated. The reload-speed bonus feeds estimated reload time and conventional reload-cycle DPS, with stacks held fixed throughout the reference cycle.

numericInputs.name: Breadbasket Stacks
numericInputs.description: Assumed current bonus stacks for the next headshot (0-3; Perfect Breadbasket caps at 2). Body-shot stack generation, next-headshot consumption, and the 10s timer are not simulated. This adds only the Headshot Damage stat bonus; it is not applied to the regular weapon-card preview.

numericInputs.name: Rifleman Stacks
numericInputs.description: Assumed current headshot-generated stack count (0-6; ordinary Rifleman caps at 5). Headshot generation, duration refresh, and the 5s timer are not simulated.

numericInputs.name: Future Perfect Stacks
numericInputs.description: Assumed current kill stacks (0-4; ordinary Future Perfect caps at 3). Kill generation and the 15/19-second timers are not simulated. Skill Tier remains an uncapped bonus total; selected skill previews clamp effective tier to 0-6. Overcharge is not modeled.

numericInputs.name: Steady Handed Stacks
numericInputs.description: Assumed current pre-consumption stack count (0-99). Valid snapshots are 0-99 for Steady Handed and 0-74 for Perfect Steady Handed; stacks at either talent's refill threshold are consumed. At or above the perfect threshold, its Accuracy and Stability bonus is withheld. Hit generation, consumption events, and magazine refills are not simulated.

numericInputs.name: Kinetic Momentum Skill 1 Stacks
numericInputs.description: Assumed current in-combat stacks for Skill 1 while it is active or not on cooldown (0-18). Each stack adds 1.5% Total Skill Damage and 2% Total Skill Repair. Ordinary Kinetic Momentum caps at 15; Perfect caps at 18. Stack generation, selected-skill inference, cooldowns, and timers are not simulated.

numericInputs.name: Kinetic Momentum Skill 2 Stacks
numericInputs.description: Assumed current in-combat stacks for Skill 2 while it is active or not on cooldown (0-18). Each stack adds 1.5% Total Skill Damage and 2% Total Skill Repair. Ordinary Kinetic Momentum caps at 15; Perfect caps at 18. Stack generation, selected-skill inference, cooldowns, and timers are not simulated.

numericInputs.name: Focus Stacks
numericInputs.description: Assumed current qualifying 8x-or-higher scoped aiming stacks (0-10) for Focus or Perfect Focus. The bonus caps at ten stacks (50% or 60%). Aiming time, scope state, target selection, and buff timing are not simulated.

numericInputs.name: Overwhelm Stacks
numericInputs.description: Assumed current retained stacks (0-4) for Overwhelm or Perfect Overwhelm. Suppression eligibility, stack generation, 12-second timers, and stack decay are not simulated.

numericInputs.name: Pumped Up Stacks
numericInputs.description: Assumed current retained stacks (0-25) for Pumped Up or Perfect Pumped Up; the ordinary talent caps at 25 and Perfect caps at 5. Reload stack generation, 10-second timers, and stack decay are not simulated.

numericInputs.name: Stabilize Stacks
numericInputs.description: Assumed current retained stacks (0-75) for Stabilize or Perfect Stabilize; ordinary caps at 60 and Perfect at 75. Firing generation, reset after 4/6 seconds, and stack decay are not simulated.

numericInputs.name: Striker's Gamble Stacks
numericInputs.description: Assumed currently retained Striker's Gamble stacks (0-200). The cap is 100 without the Press the Advantage host equipped and talent selected, or 200 with it. Weapon-hit stack generation and stack decay are not simulated.

numericInputs.name: Throttle Control Stacks
numericInputs.description: Assumed currently retained Throttle Control stacks (0-75). The cap is 50 without the Sustainability host equipped and talent selected, or 75 with it. Shooting, stack decay, and suppression are not simulated.

numericInputs.name: Heartbreaker Stacks
numericInputs.description: Assumed currently retained Heartstopper stacks (0-100); the cap is 50 without the Max BPM chest host equipped and selected, or 100 with it. Each stack adds 1% Bonus Armor, or 2% with the Cold backpack host equipped and selected; self Bonus Armor does not require target_pulsed=true. Headshot pulse application, hit generation, and stack decay are not simulated.

numericInputs.name: Camaraderie Stacks
numericInputs.description: Assumed currently retained Concentrated Company stacks (0-35). Ally/skill contribution and stack generation/decay are not simulated.

numericInputs.name: Negotiator's Dilemma Critical Hit Damage Stacks
numericInputs.description: Assumed currently retained Hostile Negotiations stacks (0-10), each adding 10% Critical Hit Damage. Marking, damage transfer, and combat-end reset are not simulated.

numericInputs.name: Umbra Into the Light Stacks
numericInputs.description: Assumed currently retained Into the Light stacks (0-100); the cap is 50 without the From the Shadows chest host equipped and selected, or 100 with it. Buff eligibility is asserted separately; stack gain, consumption, decay, and Armor Regeneration are not simulated.

numericInputs.name: Huddle Qualifying Allies
numericInputs.description: Assumed number of ally Agents currently in the qualifying Hive or Smart Cover range (0-7 planner input bound; the source does not define a maximum). Each ally adds one Skill Tier. Existing skill previews clamp effective Skill Tier to 0-6.

numericInputs.name: On Point Stacks
numericInputs.description: Assumed current On Point stacks before the reload that activated the buff (0-200 planner input bound). The formula caps effective stacks at the equipped weapon magazine estimate; the source defines the cap as the selected Rifle or Marksman Rifle Magazine Size. Stack generation and reload timing are not simulated.

numericInputs.name: Ranger Target Distance (m)
numericInputs.description: Assumed distance to the target (0-100m planner bound). Ranger bonuses count completed 4m intervals and Perfect Ranger bonuses count completed 3m intervals; partial intervals do not add damage. The 100m bound is a planner input limit, not a claimed in-game maximum. Ranger's exact interval rounding and live behavior still need in-game validation.

numericInputs.name: Brazen Previous-Shot Pellets
numericInputs.description: Manually supplied number of pellets that hit on the prior eligible shotgun shot (0–100 planner bound, not a claimed shotgun pellet maximum). brazen_next_shot_active asserts the next-shot bonus is currently eligible; shot events and pellet hits are not simulated.

numericInputs.name: Intimidate Stacks
numericInputs.description: Assumed current Intimidate stacks (0–10); ordinary Intimidate caps at 9 and Perfect Intimidate at 10. intimidate_active asserts valid bonus armor and a target within 10m. Bonus-armor generation, stack timing, loss, and target distance are not inferred.

numericInputs.name: Precision Strike Stacks
numericInputs.description: Assumed current Precision Strike stacks (0–3); ordinary Precision Strike caps at 3 and Perfect Precision Strike caps at 2. precision_strike_active asserts the qualifying close-target hit and 5-second bonus window. Kill distance, target distance, stack generation, consumption, and timing are not simulated.

numericInputs.name: Prima Donna Stacks
numericInputs.description: Assumed current You can look...but you can't touch stacks (0–10); each adds 11% amplified weapon damage. Out-of-combat eligibility, damage-triggered stack consumption, replenishment timing, and repairs are not simulated.

numericInputs.name: Unnerve Target Marks
numericInputs.description: Assumed currently retained Unnerve marks on this target (0–5), each adding 15% amplified Weapon Damage. Kill and proximity conditions, mark application, and the 10-second timer are not inferred.

numericInputs.name: Full Stop Stacks
numericInputs.description: Assumed currently retained Full Stop stacks (0–20), each adding 2% Weapon Damage and 5% Headshot Damage. The simulator generates stacks from hits, clears them on reload, granting 5% of max armor per cleared stack as temporary armor for 10 seconds (owner modeling decision, R34), and refills the magazine on a headshot kill without a reload.

numericInputs.name: Payment in Kind Stacks
numericInputs.description: Assumed currently retained Payment in Kind stacks (0–100), each adding 2% Critical Hit Damage. Damage stack generation, the 10-second lifetime, reload-triggered bleed, and armor damage are not simulated.

numericInputs.name: Big Game Hunter Stacks
numericInputs.description: Assumed currently retained Big Game Hunter stacks (0–25), each adding 6% Headshot Damage. The scoped 450% shot branch, headshot stack generation, decay, and timing are not modeled.

numericInputs.name: Cover Shooter Stacks
numericInputs.description: Assumed currently retained Cover Shooter stacks (0–100), each adding 1% Weapon Damage. In-cover shot generation, kill refresh, the 15-second duration, and reset/cancel conditions are not inferred.

numericInputs.name: Gangland Hit Other-Agent Marks
numericInputs.description: Assumed currently retained marks from other agents on the marked target (0–3), each adding 5% Weapon Damage amplification above Gangland Hit's own 20% marked-target bonus. gangland_hit_active says your own mark is on the current target, and fights follow it. Other agents’ marks and actions are not simulated.

numericInputs.name: Pakhan Stacks
numericInputs.description: Assumed current Pakhan magazine-bonus stacks for the next magazine (0–4), each adding 75% Base Magazine Size as a raw Magazine Size bonus total. Kill generation, next-magazine timing, and actual magazine capacity are not calculated.

numericInputs.name: Eagle's Strike Accuracy Bonus (%)
numericInputs.description: Manually supplied current Eagle's Strike Accuracy bonus (0–30 percentage points), capped at the source-described 30%. Continuous firing, accuracy buildup/decay, and Tenacity are not modeled.

numericInputs.name: Vicious Cycle Stacks
numericInputs.description: Assumed currently retained Vicious Cycle stacks (0–30), each adding 1.5% Weapon Damage. Stack generation, the full-stack purge, status-effect removal, and the healing cloud/ally repairs are not simulated.

numericInputs.name: Decoy King Amplification (%)
numericInputs.description: Manually supplied current Decoy King weapon-amplification value (0–25 percentage points, in 5-point steps); 0 means inactive. Moon-phase progression, timing, combat eligibility, Decoy Overcharge, and the paused cycle are not inferred.

numericInputs.name: Restorer Duration Source Comparison
numericInputs.description: 0 hides the comparison; 1 shows the Restorer source duration estimate before Nanite. The source equation adds this variant's installed Expertise bonus and, when selected, its local Polycarbonate Housing duration mod in one percentage pool, then applies all-skills Skill Duration with Skill Efficiency counted once; the source flat-seconds term is assumed zero. Nanite is intentionally excluded, and this comparison does not replace ordinary duration or establish live runtime behavior. Its nonnegative guard follows the planner's formula convention and is not source proof. View setting only; not saved or shared.

numericInputs.name: Overcharge Damage Comparison
numericInputs.description: 0 hides the comparison; 1 shows hypothetical Overcharge damage for selected damaging skills. Does not activate Overcharge or change ordinary previews. Utility, healing, cooldowns, timers, proc eligibility and DPS are excluded. View setting only; not saved or shared.

numericInputs.name: Overcharge Healing Comparison
numericInputs.description: 0 hides the comparison; 1 shows hypothetical Overcharge healing for selected healing skills. Does not activate Overcharge or alter ordinary previews. Source measurement units are retained; recipient caps, Incoming Repairs, application events, utility, duration and timers are excluded. View setting only; not saved or shared.

numericInputs.name: Overcharge Geometry Comparison
numericInputs.description: 0 hides the comparison; 1 shows hypothetical Overcharge radius, range and cone-angle references for selected reviewed variants. Does not activate Overcharge or change ordinary outputs. Source geometry only; no area, detection, targets hit, recipients or amplification. View setting only; not saved or shared.

numericInputs.name: Overcharge Capacity Comparison
numericInputs.description: 0 hides the comparison; 1 shows hypothetical Overcharge maximum charges, ammo, deployables, zones or targets for selected reviewed variants. Maximum counts only; no remaining charges, refill time, self-revive consumption, targets hit or activation. View setting only; not saved or shared.

numericInputs.name: Overcharge Lifetime Comparison
numericInputs.description: 0 hides the comparison; 1 shows hypothetical Overcharge deployment, cloud or effect-lifetime references for selected reviewed variants. Source lifetime only; no time remaining, status duration, recipient buff duration, uptime or activation. View setting only; not saved or shared.

numericInputs.name: Overcharge Status Duration Comparison
numericInputs.description: 0 hides the comparison; 1 shows hypothetical unresisted Overcharge status-duration references for selected reviewed variants. Separate from deployment lifetime; no application, recipient resistance, immunity, ticks, remaining timers or activation. View setting only; not saved or shared.

numericInputs.name: Overcharge Health Comparison
numericInputs.description: 0 hides the comparison; 1 shows hypothetical Overcharge device, shield, zone or foam health capacity for selected reviewed variants. No current health, survival, damage taken or shield invulnerability. View setting only; not saved or shared.

numericInputs.name: Overcharge Utility Comparison
numericInputs.description: 0 hides the comparison; 1 shows hypothetical Overcharge speed, threat, support properties, shield regeneration, raw Hive haste and Reviver armor bonuses for selected reviewed variants. No combined Hive refill or restored armor, applied recipient buffs, refreshed timers, travel time or activation. View setting only; not saved or shared.

numericInputs.name: Overcharge Recovery Comparison
numericInputs.description: 0 hides the comparison; 1 shows hypothetical Overcharge ordinary cooldown or single-ammo recovery estimates for selected reviewed variants. No Hive refill, charge speed, current timer, full refill, actual readiness or activation. View setting only; not saved or shared.

numericInputs.name: Assault Turret Shots per Burst
numericInputs.description: Assumed landed shots per burst. Starts at the recorded 20-shot reference; timing stays editable.

numericInputs.name: Assault Turret Firing Time (s)
numericInputs.description: Assumed seconds spent firing one burst. Starts at the approximately 5-second recorded reference.

numericInputs.name: Assault Turret Burst Pause (s)
numericInputs.description: Assumed pause between bursts, including reload. The 1-second starting value is the recorded upper-bound reference; deployment and redeployment are excluded.

numericInputs.name: Assumed Tick Interval (s)
numericInputs.description: Seconds between damage ticks. Starts at 0.5 seconds. Shared by burn, bleed and Oxidizer previews; does not model duration, refresh or overlapping applications.

numericInputs.name: Stinger Repeat Interval (s)
numericInputs.description: Assumed seconds between landed stings on one target. Starts at the approximately 1-second observation; targeting pulses, recharge and deployment are excluded.

numericInputs.name: Enemy Target Profile
numericInputs.description: Enemy for target estimates. Profiles group game-file NPC declarations by role, health base and armor base, labelled with the factions that use them most. Named entries are a sample of named bosses, one per main faction, with the mission whose scripts reference them; whether they spawn there with these values, and with which role override, is not established.

numericInputs.name: Enemy Difficulty
numericInputs.description: Mission difficulty for target estimates.

numericInputs.name: Enemy Group Size
numericInputs.description: Number of players the enemy is scaled for.

numericInputs.name: Enemy Hit Rate (%)
numericInputs.description: Share of the enemy's shots that hit you, for time to armor break. In a fight with a set distance the default follows it: 70% up to 15 m and 30% beyond (Shade-Tech in-game counts for a normal enemy after its first second of line of sight). Without a distance it is a flat 50%.

numericInputs.name: Enemies Attacking
numericInputs.description: Enemies of the selected target firing at you at once.

numericInputs.name: Enemy Firing Time (%)
numericInputs.description: Share of the time the enemy spends firing. Enemies fire in bursts, move and reload, with pauses that the game data does not yet describe; testers judge they fire under half the time, so it starts at 50% (G428). 100% is continuous fire.

numericInputs.name: Rebalance Banked Red Stacks
numericInputs.description: Red stacks banked when Harrier Pride last reached its 80-stack cap (0–80; red and blue banked together total 80 after any cap), each adding 0.5% Damage Resistance until the next cap. The simulator sets it at each cap; the stack that reaches the cap is counted (owner modeling decision, R34).

numericInputs.name: Rebalance Banked Blue Stacks
numericInputs.description: Blue stacks banked when Harrier Pride last reached its 80-stack cap (0–80; red and blue banked together total 80 after any cap), each adding 0.5% Weapon Damage until the next cap. The simulator sets it at each cap; the stack that reaches the cap is counted (owner modeling decision, R34).

numericInputs.name: Quick Draw Stacks
numericInputs.description: Assumed Quick Draw stacks held before the next pistol shot (0-100). One stack per 0.3 s without a pistol in hand; the first pistol shot spends them all, hit or miss. Each stack adds 10% Pistol Damage to that shot, which is a forced headshot.

numericInputs.name: Ardent Heat
numericInputs.description: Assumed Ardent heat meter (0-100). The meter holds half the weapon's magazine; one per bullet fired, emptied by a completed reload and draining 12 a second after 0.5 s without firing. While it is full, every hit burns the target.

numericInputs.name: Afterburn Stacks
numericInputs.description: Assumed Afterburn stacks on the current enemy (0-20). Driven fights count them.

numericInputs.name: Apex Engine Bonus Stacks
numericInputs.description: Assumed Apex Engine bonus stacks (0-3). Driven fights build them: one per 100 weapon hits, for 30s.

numericInputs.name: Voracious Stacks
numericInputs.description: Assumed Voracious stacks (0-4). Driven fights count them: one per 100 hits.

numericInputs.name: Voracious Target Armor+Health %
numericInputs.description: Assumed armor and health the target has left (0-100%). Driven fights read it.

numericInputs.name: Artillery Shell Interval (s)
numericInputs.description: Assumed seconds between Artillery Turret shells. The player fires each, and no script states a time between them, so 2 s is an assumption.

numericInputs.name: Cluster Mine Interval (s)
numericInputs.description: Assumed seconds between Cluster Seeker mines reaching one enemy. They are separate NPCs, and no script states a time between them, so 0.5 s is an assumption.

buildOutputs.name: Build Time to Kill (s)
buildOutputs.formula: enemy_target_health > 0 && (equipped_weapon_practical_reload_cycle_dps * out_of_cover_damage_factor * (1 + health_damage) + (skill_slot_1_dps + skill_slot_2_dps)) > 0 && (enemy_target_armor <= 0 || (equipped_weapon_practical_reload_cycle_dps * out_of_cover_damage_factor * (1 + damage_to_armor) + (skill_slot_1_dps + skill_slot_2_dps)) > 0) ? enemy_target_health / (equipped_weapon_practical_reload_cycle_dps * out_of_cover_damage_factor * (1 + health_damage) + (skill_slot_1_dps + skill_slot_2_dps)) + (enemy_target_armor > 0 ? enemy_target_armor / (equipped_weapon_practical_reload_cycle_dps * out_of_cover_damage_factor * (1 + damage_to_armor) + (skill_slot_1_dps + skill_slot_2_dps)) : 0) : 0

modifiers.value: practical_kills_per_shot * practical_headshot_fraction * min(1.25 * (max(0, equipped_weapon_headshot_damage) * (1 - max(0, min(1, effective_critical_hit_chance))) + max(0, equipped_weapon_critical_headshot_damage) * max(0, min(1, effective_critical_hit_chance))), (weapon_total_headshot_damage > 1.5 ? 12.5 : 8) * max(0, equipped_weapon_damage))

coverage.evidence: R35_PRIORITY3_REVIEW.md (talent-parameter comparison against the R32/R33 talent bundle); every source parameter appears in the pack (or as a matching delta)
