sets.name: Aces & Eights
sets.description: Default core: Weapon Damage. 4pc: Dead Man's Hand. Flip a card when landing shots with a Rifle or Marksman rifle. After 5 cards are flipped, the damage of your next shot is amplified by 75%. More shots are enhanced the better the hand revealed. Four of a Kind: 4 shots. Full House: 3 shots. Aces and Eights: 2 shots. Flip an additional card on headshots. Modeled 4pc preview: The assumed empowered-shot weapon-damage multiplier is 1.75, or 2.00 with the No Limit chest host equipped and selected; it applies only to a selected Rifle or Marksman Rifle. Passive enhanced-shot counts are 4 for Four of a Kind, 3 for Full House and 2 for Aces and Eights; equipped selected Ace in the Sleeve adds one to each. These are available per-hand counts, not remaining shots or a current hand. Card flips, hand results, activation and shot consumption are not simulated.

sets.name: Aegis
sets.description: Default core: Armor. 4pc: Stoic. Get +4% Damage Resistance for every enemy that is targeting you. The bonus is multiplied by 1.X, where X is the number of agents in your group. Modeled 4pc preview: 4% per qualifying enemy, 5% with selected Polyethylene Plating, before the group multiplier. Explicit qualifying target counts and assumed group size apply an estimated Stoic contribution to raw Damage Resistance. No targeting or group state is inferred; live stacking needs verification. 1 with selected Deceit means enemies targeting your Decoy can qualify. Additional Decoy targets count only with this equipped selected chest talent. The player and additional Decoy counts are combined with a conservative planner bound of eight; this is not a verified live cap. The assumed group size includes you (one to four), interpreting the pinned 1.X rule as 1.1–1.4. Combat events, active Decoys, actual incoming hits and live protection stacking remain unmodeled.

sets.name: Breaking Point
sets.description: Default core: Weapon Damage. 4pc: On Point. Hitting a shot with a Rifle or MMR grants a stack. Max stack is equal to the weapon's Magazine Size. Reloading will grant +2% Weapon Handling and +4% Weapon Damage per stack, for 20s.  No stacks are acquired while the bonuses are active. The timer running out will refill your magazine.  Switching weapons while the bonuses are active will stop the effect and refill your magazine. Switching weapons while the bonuses are not active will remove all stacks and refill your magazine. Modeled 4pc preview: on_point_active asserts the current post-reload bonus is valid for the selected Rifle or Marksman Rifle. on_point_stacks is capped in the formula at the equipped weapon magazine estimate, matching the source's magazine-size stack cap; the stack input has a 0–200 planner bound; capacity includes modeled magazine bonuses. Point of Honor raises Weapon Damage per stack from 4% to 9%; Weapon Handling remains 2% per stack. Stack generation, reloads, timers, ammunition, and weapon-switch resets are not simulated. The passive available buff duration is 20 seconds, or 40 with equipped selected Point of no Return; this does not activate the buff or track time remaining.

sets.name: Cavalier
sets.description: Default core: Armor. 4pc: Charging. For each second spent out of cover during combat, Agents will get 5% reduced incoming skill damage. Max 50%. Charged: While fully charged, gain immunity to any movement speed debuff and share this with all of the agents hazard protection and the incoming skill damage with all allies for 10 seconds. After Charged is consumed, Charging buff will resume if still in combat and out of cover. Modeled 4pc preview: Available skill-damage protection gain is 5% per qualifying second, or 10% with equipped selected Safe Charging. Protection cap is 50%, or 70% with equipped selected Overcharging. Charged sharing duration is 10s. The explicit charging_retained_seconds assumption estimates retained skill protection, capped at the selected limit, and its standalone skill-damage factor. Available full-charge time is calculated from zero under uninterrupted eligibility. Does not add general Damage Resistance or change the general incoming-damage multiplier. Combat/cover state, charge progress, movement immunity, ally sharing, consumption and incoming damage are not inferred.

sets.name: Concentrated Company
sets.description: Default core: Weapon Damage. 4pc: Camaraderie. Shooting an enemy marks them for 10 seconds. When a marked enemy dies, receive one stack of 3% Weapon Damage and 3% Critical Hit Damage for each Ally or Skill that has contributed to killing that enemy. Max stacks is 35. Stacks decay every 10 seconds. Maximum amount of marks that can be placed is 4. Modeled 4pc preview: The assumed retained-stack count is 0–35. Weapon Damage is 3% per stack, or 6% with the One for All backpack host equipped and selected; Critical Hit Damage is 3% per stack. The passive mark limit is 4, or 8 with equipped selected All for One. This capacity does not create marks or stacks; marking, ally/skill contributions and stack decay are not simulated.

sets.name: Core Strength
sets.description: Default core: Armor. 4pc: Core Exercise. For each Core attribute, receive 40% of the other two Core Attributes' bonuses. Skill Tiers count as 15% Skill Efficiency when these bonuses are applied. All pieces from this Gear Set, apart from the Backpack, will feature random Core Attributes. Modeled 4pc preview: 40% of the other two core bonuses, 75% with selected Inner Core. Automatically converts valid configured gear core counts using standard level-40 bases: 15% Weapon Damage and 170,000 Armor. Partial valid rolls count once; magnitude-dependent conversion requires live verification. Skill Tiers count as 15% Skill Efficiency for the conversion rule. Each configured Weapon Damage or Armor core grants this basis times the conversion share as Skill Efficiency. No extra Skill Tiers are granted; Outer Core changes item slots only. Permanent converted Weapon Damage, Armor and Skill Efficiency apply automatically at four effective pieces. Only valid configured gear cores count; unconfigured or invalid rolls, non-core tiers, set/talent bonuses, Expertise and converted bonuses do not create cores. Bases and behavior on partial rolls are planner estimates; Prototype scaling and PvP normalization remain excluded.

sets.name: Eclipse Protocol
sets.description: Default core: Skill Tier. 4pc: Indirect Transmission. On kill: Spread status effects of that enemy to all enemies within 10m. Refresh 50% of status effect durations. Modeled 4pc preview: Available spread radius is 10m and refresh fraction 50%, or 15m and 75% with equipped selected Proliferation. These properties do not add general Status Effects, spread effects, detect range, infer kills or extend actual durations. Selected Symptom Aggravator amplifies weapon and modeled skill damage by 30% only while target_status_affected=true. The available property remains passive. No status application, spread, target detection or uptime is inferred.

sets.name: Foundry Bulwark
sets.description: Default core: Armor. 4pc: Makeshift Repairs. Whenever you or your shield take damage, 25% of that amount is repaired to both over 10s. Modeled 4pc preview: Available repair share is 25% of qualifying damage, or 35% with equipped selected Process Refinery; delivery duration is 10s, or 5s with equipped selected Improved Materials. The explicit makeshift_qualifying_damage input estimates the unadjusted repair budget for each recipient (agent and shield) and its average delivery rate. It does not add Armor Regeneration or Repair Skills. Damage received, shield armor, missing armor, actual healing, overlapping repairs and elapsed time are not inferred.

sets.name: Future Initiative
sets.description: Default core: Skill Tier. 4pc: Ground Control. Increases you and your allies' total weapon and skill damage by 15% when at full armor. When you repair an ally, you and all allies within 5m of you are also repaired for 60% of that amount. Modeled 4pc preview: The full-armor damage bonus is modeled at 15%, or 25% with the Tactical Superiority host equipped and talent selected. The passive proximity-repair percentage is 60% of an eligible ally repair, or 120% with equipped selected Advanced Combat Tactics. This property is independent of full armor and is not a Repair Skills bonus. The explicit ground_control_eligible_ally_repair input estimates an unadjusted per-recipient proximity budget. Actual healing, missing armor, recipients, distance, ally events and feedback loops are not calculated.

sets.name: Hard Wired
sets.description: Default core: Skill Tier. 4pc: Feedback Loop. Whenever you use or cancel a skill, your other skill's cooldown is reduced by 30s, total skill repair is increased by 10% for 20s, and total skill damage is increased by 10% for 20s. Cooldown: 10s. Modeled 4pc preview: The assumed active Feedback Loop bonus is 10%, or 25% with the Positive Reinforcement host equipped and talent selected. The passive Feedback Loop trigger cooldown is 10 seconds, or 5 with equipped selected Short Circuit. This is separate from skill cooldowns; skill resets, the 30-second reduction, trigger readiness and timers are not simulated.

sets.name: Heartbreaker
sets.description: Default core: Armor. 4pc: Heartstopper. Headshots apply pulse for 5s. Weapon hits on pulsed enemies add and refresh a stack of +1% bonus armor and +1.1% amplified weapon damage to pulsed enemies for 5s. Max stack is 50. Two stacks are lost per second. Modeled 4pc preview: The assumed retained-stack count is 0–100, capped at 50 without the Max BPM chest host equipped and selected, or 100 with it. Each stack adds 1% Bonus Armor, increased to 2% with the Cold backpack host equipped and selected; this self bonus armor has no target_pulsed requirement. The weapon-damage multiplier applies only while target_pulsed=true. Headshot pulse application, hit generation, and stack decay are not modeled.

sets.name: Hotshot
sets.description: Default core: Weapon Damage. 4pc: Headache. First Headshot with a Marksman Rifle will increase next headshot by 80%, second consecutive headshot with a Marksman Rifle will give +10% armor (if at full armor it will give bonus armor max +50% of current armor value), third consecutive headshot will refill magazine. From the fourth headshot forward agents will get all 3 bonuses for each consecutive headshot kill. Missing a headshot will reset the cycle. Modeled 4pc preview: Available next-headshot bonus is 80%, repair share 10%, and bonus-armor cap 50% of the source's current armor value, or 100% with equipped selected Stand Tall. Lucky permits one missed headshot before cycle reset. The available unadjusted repair budget uses 10% of estimated maximum armor; the explicit headache_current_armor input estimates the available bonus-armor ceiling from the supplied current armor pool. These capacities do not add global Headshot Damage, repair armor or grant Bonus Armor. The explicit headache_empowered_headshot flag applies an estimated 1.80 headshot-only multiplier to a selected MMR at the four-piece threshold; bodyshots and skills are unchanged. The multiplicative pool is a planner interpretation requiring live verification. Eligible MMR shots, kills, cycle stage, full armor, current armor, magazine refills and missed shots are not inferred.

sets.name: Hunter's Fury
sets.description: Default core: Weapon Damage. 4pc: Apex Predator. Enemies within 15m receive a debuff, amplifying your weapon damage against them by +20%. Killing a debuffed enemy with your weapon disorients other enemies within 5m, and amplifies weapon damage by 5% for 10s, stacking up to 5 times. Modeled 4pc preview: hunter_fury_target_within_15m asserts the selected target is within 15m; only Apex Predator's +20% amplified weapon damage against that target is modeled. The post-kill 5% damage stacks are omitted because the pinned wording does not specify how they combine with the proximity amplification. Passive stack duration is 10 seconds, or 30 with equipped selected Endless Hunger; passive disorient radius is 5 meters, or 10 with equipped selected Overwhelming Force. These properties do not activate stacks or disorient. Kills, events, range detection and timers are not simulated.

sets.name: Measured Assembly
sets.description: Default core: Skill Tier. 4pc: Huddle. Receive +1 Skill Tier for each ally Agent that is within the range of the hive or Smart Cover. While at Skill Tier 6, having at least one ally Agent in the range of your Hive or Smart Cover for 4s will grant Overcharge for 15s. Cooldown: 40s. Mortars and enemy Skills that enter the range of your Hive or Smart Cover will be destroyed. Cooldown: 10s. The cooldown is 20% faster for each ally agent within the range of your hive or smart cover. Modeled 4pc preview: huddle_qualifying_allies adds one Skill Tier per assumed qualifying ally (0–7 planner bound), with effective skill tier clamped to 0–6. Passive Overcharge trigger/duration properties are 4/15 seconds; cooldown is 40 seconds, or 25 with equipped selected Hivemind. Destruction base cooldown is 10 seconds, or 1 with equipped selected Smart Cooperation, before the unspecified per-ally faster-cooldown rule. Skill Haste/Efficiency do not scale these talent properties. No Overcharge is activated, skill destruction inferred, cooldown-speed stacking chosen, ally range detected or timers simulated.

sets.name: Negotiator's Dilemma
sets.description: Default core: Weapon Damage. 4pc: Hostile Negotiations. Critical hits mark enemies for 20s, up to 3 marks total. When you critically hit a marked enemy, all other marked enemies take 60% of the damage dealt. Whenever a marked enemy dies, gain +10% critical hit damage, stacking up to 10 times, or until combat ends. Modeled 4pc preview: The assumed retained stack count is 0–10, adding 10% Critical Hit Damage per stack. Passive mark limit is 3, or 5 with equipped selected Target Rich Environment. The per-other-marked-enemy transfer percentage is 60%, or 112% with equipped selected Critical Measures. Neither upgrade changes the CHD stack bonus. Marks, critical-hit events, actual transferred damage amounts, recipients, duration and combat-end resets are not simulated.

sets.name: Ongoing Directive
sets.description: Default core: Weapon Damage. 4pc: Rules of Engagement. Shooting a status affected enemy will apply a mark. Killing a marked enemy grants a full clip of Hollow-Point Ammo for your active weapon, and half a clip of the agent's active weapon to the rest of the party. Mark lasts for 10 seconds. Hollow-Point Ammo amplifies weapon damage by 40% and applies bleed on hit. Modeled 4pc preview: The assumed active Hollow-Point Ammo weapon-damage multiplier is 1.40, or 1.60 with the Parabellum Rounds chest host equipped and selected. Ammo grants, party transfer, marks, weapon-applied bleed, and proc generation are not modeled. 50% bleed-only duration bonus with selected Trauma Specialist. Feeds the reviewed bleed-duration reference as a separate factor; does not add general Status Effects or predict an applied timer. 100% bleed-only damage bonus with selected Trauma Specialist. Automatically doubles modeled selected-skill bleed damage at four pieces; no general Status Effects or Skill Damage is added. The separate bleed-only pool remains an estimate requiring live verification. Bleed ticks and actual duration are not inferred.

sets.name: Ortiz: Exuro
sets.description: Default core: Skill Tier. 4pc: Ortiz Incinerator Turret Prototype. The Incinerator Turret spins 360 degrees. You are immune to your own Incinerator Turret's fire. The Incinerator Turret explodes when disabled. Modeled 4pc preview: 360-degree Incinerator Turret rotation capability; no turret deployment or firing is simulated. 1 indicates immunity to your own prototype turret fire, not general Burn Resistance or immunity to enemy fire. 1 indicates the prototype explodes when disabled; no explosion damage or disabling event is calculated. 10 meters with selected Chain Combustion, zero without it. No eligible burning target, spread or range detection is inferred. 40% available amplified weapon damage with selected Heatstroke. Its applied weapon multiplier requires exuro_target_ignited_by_prototype=true; generic Burn or status flags do not establish this eligibility. 25% prototype turret range bonus with selected Heatstroke. No base range or global skill range is modified. Prototype properties remain available-only; ignition, turret deployment/range and uptime are not simulated.

sets.name: Ortiz: Reficere
sets.description: Default core: Skill Tier. 4pc: Ortiz Rapid Application Nanite Prototype. Healing Skills' Duration and Range are decreased by 90%, but their Healing Efficiency is increased by 150%. Healing an Ally with a Skill will provide them 30% Hazard Protection for 10s. Cooldown per ally: 10s. Modeled 4pc preview: Healing-skill Duration/Range reduction properties are 90%, or 25% with equipped selected Improved Dampeners; Healing Efficiency bonus is 150%, or 225% with equipped selected Overcharged Nanites. These are healing-skill properties, not global Skill Duration, Repair Skills or Skill Efficiency. Ally Hazard Protection property is 30% for 10s, with a 10s per-ally cooldown; it does not grant self Hazard Protection. No healing skill selection, actual healing, durations/ranges, ally buff application, recipients or cooldown timers are inferred.

sets.name: Refactor
sets.description: Default core: Armor. 4pc: Return to Sender. For PvE: Receive repairs of 10% of the damage dealt by your Skills. Your allies will receive repairs of 20% of the damage dealt by your Skills. For PvP: Receive repairs of 5% of the damage dealt by your Skills. Your allies will receive repairs of 10% of the damage dealt by your Skills. Modeled 4pc preview: PvE self/ally repair shares are 10%/20% of skill damage, or 25%/35% with equipped selected Increased Interest. Equipped selected Over-engineered exposes the self-only 80% Total Armor bonus-armor capacity for repairs received while at full armor; capacity itself needs no full-armor flag and does not grant bonus armor. The explicit return_to_sender_skill_damage input estimates unadjusted PvE self and per-ally budgets. PvP shares, actual skill damage events, recipient eligibility, missing armor, repair scaling, conversion and actual ally healing are not simulated.

sets.name: Rigger
sets.description: Default core: Skill Tier. 4pc: Tend and Befriend. Interacting with your deployed skills grants the skill 25% skill damage for 10s. This buff cannot be refreshed. Interactions include: Using / Deploying the Skill, Changing the skills target, Healing the skill. Modeled 4pc preview: rigger_skill_buff_active asserts that the 10-second buff currently applies to the interacted deployed skill; it does not imply both skills are buffed. Best Buds raises Skill Damage from 25% to 50%. Passive buff duration is 10 seconds; Skill Duration does not scale this talent timer. Interaction events, refreshes, cancellation resets and buff timers are not simulated. 1 with selected Complete Uptime indicates cancellation can reset skill cooldowns. Eligible persistent platform previews show available zero cooldown after hypothetical manual cancellation. No cancellation, current readiness, actual reset, deployment delay or ordinary cooldown change is simulated.

sets.name: Striker's Battlegear
sets.description: Default core: Weapon Damage. 4pc: Striker's Gamble. Weapon hits amplify total weapon damage by 0.65%, stacking up to 100 times. 1 stack lost per second between 0 to 50 stacks; 2 stacks lost per second between 51 and 100 stacks. Modeled 4pc preview: The assumed retained-stack count is 0–200; its cap is 100 without the Press the Advantage host equipped and talent selected, and 200 with it. Hit generation and stack decay are not simulated.

sets.name: System Corruption
sets.description: Default core: Armor. 4pc: Hackstep Protocol. Replaces armor kits with an instant, infinite-use ability. Grants 50% bonus armor for 5s. Hides your nameplate for 5s. Repairs 20% of your armor. Increases total weapon damage by 2% per 5% bonus armor gained, up to 20%. Ability cooldown: 20s. Modeled 4pc preview: Available bonus-armor grant is 50%, or 100% with equipped selected Multithreaded Execution; bonus armor and nameplate hide each last 5s. Repair share is 20%. Cooldown is 20s, or 15s with equipped selected Compiler Optimization. Total Weapon Damage property is 2% per qualifying 5% bonus armor gained, capped at 20%. The explicit hackstep_qualifying_bonus_armor_percent assumption adds 2% Total Weapon Damage per complete 5% qualifying bonus armor, capped at 20%; zero is inactive. Passive properties do not fill the assumption, activate the ability, grant Bonus Armor or repair armor. Armor kits, actual armor gained, scaling, timers, ability readiness and events are not simulated.

sets.name: Tip of the Spear
sets.description: Default core: Weapon Damage. 4pc: Aggressive Recon. Getting a Signature Weapon kill gives +15% Signature Weapon Damage for 10s and +25% Reload Speed for the next reload of the weapon (the bonuses do not stack). Automatically regenerate Signature Weapon Ammo every 60s. Modeled 4pc preview: aggressive_recon_active asserts the current 10-second Signature Weapon Damage buff; aggressive_recon_reload_active asserts the one next reload that receives 25% Reload Speed. Specialized Destruction raises the Signature Weapon Damage bonus from 15% to 30%. signature_moves_active asserts the separate 15-second +50% amplified weapon damage buff after fully depleting Signature Weapon ammo; it applies only when Signature Moves is selected. The passive Signature Weapon ammo-generation interval is 60 seconds; grant quantity and the doubled ammo-generation upgrade effects are not modeled. Signature Weapon Damage and Reload Speed remain bonus totals; signature weapon outputs and reload timing are not calculated.

sets.name: Tipping Scales
sets.description: Default core: Weapon Damage. 4pc: Throttle Control. Shooting builds stacks to a max of 50. Each stack provides +0.5% Weapon Handling and +5% Critical Hit Damage. Lose 6 stacks per second while not shooting. No stacks are lost if an enemy is Suppressed. Modeled 4pc preview: The assumed retained-stack count is 0–75; its cap is 50 without the Sustainability host equipped and talent selected, and 75 with it. Snowball changes Critical Hit Damage per stack when its backpack host is equipped and selected. Shooting, stack decay, and suppression are not simulated.

sets.name: True Patriot
sets.description: Default core: Armor. 4pc: Red, White and Blue. Enemies you shoot receive stacking debuffs of Red/White/Blue. Changes every 2 seconds. Red: Amplifies the enemy's damage taken by 15%. White: Hitting the enemy restores you and your allies' armor by 2% once every second. Blue: Decreases enemy damage dealt by 10%. Full Flag: Enemies that die while under the effect of all three debuffs create a 5m explosion, dealing damage equal to their total health and armor. Explosion strength is reduced on Named enemy deaths. Modeled 4pc preview: true_patriot_red_active asserts the current target has Red; selected-weapon amplification is 15%, or 30% with selected Patriotic Boost. true_patriot_white_ready separately asserts an eligible White hit with the once-per-second repair available; self repair is 2% of estimated maximum armor, or 5% with the upgrade. true_patriot_blue_target asserts the evaluated enemy has Blue; its outgoing damage reduction is 10%, or 20% with the upgrade, shown as a separate enemy factor. General incoming damage is unchanged. The available rotation interval is 2 seconds, or 1 with selected Waving the Flag. Allies, Full Flag explosions, actual debuff rotation, hits and timers are not simulated.

sets.name: Umbra Initiative
sets.description: Default core: Weapon Damage. 4pc: From the Shadows Into the Light. From the Shadows: While out of cover and in combat, gain 10 Stacks per second up to 50. Each stack will give 0.8% Armor regen when it is consumed. Stacks consume, 10 stacks per second, only in cover. Into the Light: While in cover, gain 10 Stacks per second up to 50. Each stack will give 1.2% Critical damage increase and 0.4% RPM. Buff does not apply while shooting from cover. While out of cover Agents lose 2 stacks per second at normal speed and 1 stack per second if sprinting. Modeled 4pc preview: The assumed active Into the Light stack count is 0–100, capped at 50 or 100 with equipped selected From the Shadows; umbra_light_active asserts eligible CHD/RPM bonuses, not suppressed by shooting from cover. Passive Light cap/gain/consumption properties are 50/10/10, or 100/20/20 with selected From the Shadows; normal/sprint decay is 2/1 stacks per second. Passive Shadow cap/gain is 50/10, or 100/20 with equipped selected Into the Light; consumption stays 10 per second and repair per consumed stack stays 0.8% armor. The chest consumption property is retained exactly as pinned, separately from the base Light movement decay. The explicit umbra_shadow_stacks_to_consume input estimates an unadjusted repair budget and continuous-cover delivery time, clamped to the selected Shadow limit; average rate is budget divided by estimated duration. These estimates do not generate or consume stacks, repair armor, infer missing armor or scaling, activate cover states or simulate timers or ticks.

sets.name: Virtuoso
sets.description: Default core: Weapon Damage. 4pc: Symphony. Kills Beyond 25 Meters: +40% Weapon Damage to Shotguns, SMGs, and Pistols; +20% Weapon Damage to Assault Rifles and LMGs; and +25% Bonus Armor for 15s. Kills Within 25 Meters: +40% Weapon Damage to Marksman Rifles and Rifles; +20% Weapon Damage to Assault Rifles and LMGs; and +30% Headshot Damage for 15s. Intermittently killing enemies from both ranges builds up stacks. At 4 stacks, all bonuses are multiplied by 1.5 and triggered simultaneously for 15s. No stacks gained while talent is active. Modeled 4pc preview: symphony_range_buff=within or beyond asserts the currently valid ordinary 15-second buff from a kill in that range. Weapon Damage is shown only for the selected weapon classes listed in the source; Fortissimo doubles those Weapon Damage bonuses when its Virtuoso chest host is equipped and selected. The within-range Headshot Damage bonus is a raw total and has no weapon-class gate. symphony_range_buff=both separately asserts the current simultaneous buff: both range groups at 1.5x, for 60% Weapon Damage to each listed class (AR/LMG sum their two 20% branches), 45% Headshot Damage and 37.5% Bonus Armor. Fortissimo doubles only Weapon Damage. The mutually exclusive selector prevents ordinary branches from stacking with both. Bonus Armor also applies to beyond at 25%. The passive trigger threshold is 4 stacks, or 3 with equipped selected Accelerando; no current stacks, trigger progress, stack generation, automatic activation or timers are calculated.

sets.name: Ember Engine
sets.description: Default core: Skill Tier. 4pc: Spontaneous Combustion. Every Status Effect you apply has a 40% chance of also applying Burn to the enemy. If the Status Effect initially applied was Burn, the enemy will receive +25% Burn Damage for the duration of the Burn Modeled 4pc preview: Available burn-proc chance is 40%, or 60% with equipped selected Flashpoint. The initially-Burn branch's damage bonus property is 25%. Equipped selected White Hot exposes a 50% debuff-duration bonus, zero without it; this is the Burn Damage debuff duration, not general Burn Duration. These properties do not increase global Burn Damage/Duration. The explicit combustion_initial_burn_debuff assumption applies an estimated separate 1.25 factor only to modeled selected-skill Burn channels at four pieces; other outputs are unchanged. Live stacking needs verification. Status application, random outcomes, eligible initial Burn, target debuffs, actual durations and damage ticks are not inferred.

sets.name: Apex Protocol
sets.description: 4pc: Apex Engine. Every 100 weapon hits gives a bonus stack, up to 3, each +65% Weapon Damage and +1 Skill Tier for 30s, refreshing together. Driven fights build the stacks.
